create_controlnet_model: create a ControlNetModel instance with custom block channels and conditioning channels for image conditioning
build_controlnet_from_unet: build a ControlNetModel from an existing UNet2DConditionModel by copying weights and config
run_controlnet_forward: run the ControlNetModel forward pass with a sample, timestep, encoder states, and control condition tensor
create_conditioning_embedding: create a ControlNetConditioningEmbedding module that encodes image conditions into feature maps for ControlNet
set_controlnet_attention_slice: set attention slicing on a ControlNetModel to reduce memory usage during inference
